text:
Sorry to see your new calathea looking a bit off. Yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is normal transplant stress, so it isn't covered for a replacement on its own.

Your 30-day guarantee (90 days for Leafy Plus members) still applies. If the plant declines significantly, meaning it loses more than a third of its leaves, gets stem or root rot, or collapses, you can claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (whole plant and close-up). A Plant Care Specialist reviews claims within 2 business days.

In the meantime, keep it out of direct sun, don't repot for 2-3 weeks, and water only when the top inch of soil is dry, since overwatering is the most common early problem. A Plant Care Specialist can also give you free care advice by chat or email if you'd like.
